Frequently Asked

How do I export a calculation as PDF or Excel?

Open the Coating Calculator, complete your inputs, and use the export actions inside the module. Reports are generated with BG Group branding, ready for client submissions and QA files.

Is my data saved between sessions?

In this release the calculator runs locally in your browser session. Export your results as PDF/Excel to keep permanent records. Cloud save arrives with team workspaces.

Which standards do the calculations follow?

Calculation logic reflects established industry practice aligned with AMPP/NACE, SSPC, ASTM and ISO frameworks — including surface preparation grades, DFT regimes and practical loss factors from 22+ years of field work.

Will more modules be added?

Yes — the platform is built to grow. New modules will appear in this same workspace as they become production-ready. No fake previews, only working tools.
